text: Hi. I run Kestrel Works, a small B2B SaaS company in Mumbai (IST). Team of four: me (Rohan), Priya, Arjun and Kavya.
Nice to meet you, Rohan. Kestrel Works, Mumbai, four people: you, Priya, Arjun and Kavya. What should we start with?
When you write briefs: bullets, five at most, always list the sources. No emojis please.
Understood: bullets, five at most, sources always listed, no emojis.
Sign off emails as 'Best, R.' and not with my full name.
Done. Emails will end with 'Best, R.'
What can you see on your side? Mail, calendar, Slack, Linear?
All four. I can read and draft mail, read and edit your calendar, read and post in Slack, and query Linear. I send mail only after you say yes, and I tell you what I did after every action.
Good. For reminders: during the day I am usually on WhatsApp, in the evening on Telegram. Web is when I am at a desk.
Reminders and anything I send first will go to WhatsApp until 18:00 and to Telegram after that. Web stays for longer work like drafts. If you want one reminder somewhere else, say so when you set it.
I want a short brief at 9:30 on weekday mornings. Calendar first, then mail that needs me, then Slack. Skip Wednesdays, I plan those myself.
Set: brief at 09:30 on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday, on WhatsApp. Order is calendar, mail needing a reply, Slack. Five bullets at most, sources listed, nothing on Wednesdays unless you ask.
And an end of day wrap at quarter to six, Monday to Thursday, on Telegram. What closed, what is still open for tomorrow. Fridays earlier, 3:30.
Wrap-up: 17:45 Monday to Thursday and 15:30 on Fridays, all on Telegram. Closed items first, then what is open for the next working day.
No lunch meetings unless I ask for one.
Saved: nothing in the 12:30 to 13:30 window unless you ask for it.
Is the calendar clear this weekend?
Yes, nothing today or tomorrow. Monday opens with Planning from 10:00 to 11:00, then 15:00 with Arjun. Nothing else is booked that day yet.
Weekend rule: no work pings on Saturday or Sunday unless I ask for something or it's a real escalation.
Understood. On weekends I will only message you for reminders you set, replies you asked me to watch for, or a genuine escalation.
ping
Telegram works, I can see this chat.
Before I forget how this works, list the team as you understand it, so I can correct you.

Here is what I have:
- Rohan Menon, founder, Kestrel Works, Mumbai
- Priya Nair, Mobile lead
- Arjun Sethi, Platform lead
- Kavya Shah, Growth lead
Sources: what you told me this morning, plus your contacts list.
Right. Priya is also running the design hire for now.
Noted: Priya is running the design hire.
[voice note] I'm heading out for a run, back around one. Hold anything non urgent and just give me a summary when I'm back.
Holding. I will send a summary at 13:00.
Remind me Monday evening to pick up the dry cleaning. Six is fine.
Set for Monday 18:00. Since that is 18:00, it will arrive on Telegram.
Summary since 12:05: two newsletters and a calendar invite from Kavya for Tuesday, 15:30 to 16:00, titled Webinar page review. Nothing urgent. The invite is not accepted yet.
Accept it.
Accepted. Tuesday 15:30 to 16:00, Webinar page review with Kavya.
Write me a short week-ahead note for the team, to post Sunday evening. Three priorities: the Acme proposal, the webinar page going live, the design hire.

Draft:

Team, week ahead.
1. Acme proposal: Arjun's effort estimate by Wednesday, draft proposal by Friday.
2. Webinar page: Kavya takes it live this week.
3. Design hire: first interview on Tuesday, Priya and I on it.
Shout in this thread if any of that looks unrealistic.
Cut the numbers and the last line. Plain bullets.

Team, week ahead:
- Acme proposal: Arjun's estimate midweek, draft by Friday
- Webinar page: live this week
- Design hire: first interview Tuesday
Fine. I'll post it myself tomorrow around 7:30pm. Remind me.
Reminder set for Sunday 19:30 on Telegram, with this draft attached.
gift idea for my cousin Neel's wedding. he's into coffee

Three options. A manual pour-over set with a hand grinder, about INR 5,000 to 8,000. A tasting box of whole beans from a small roaster with a handwritten card. A good insulated carafe for the table. The pour-over set is the safest pick.
Pour-over it is. The wedding is Saturday June 6, I'll be there both days. Put it on the calendar.
Added: Neel's wedding, Saturday June 6 and Sunday June 7, marked personal and busy.
one dumb joke and then I sleep
A SQL query walks into a bar, walks up to two tables and asks: can I join you?
Morning. Anything on today?
Nothing on the calendar. At 19:30 tonight I will remind you to post the week-ahead note.
[voice note] Hey, we're thinking of taking my parents out for lunch today. Is it going to be too hot to sit outside?
Mumbai is forecast at 35C by 13:00 with high humidity, so lunch indoors with air conditioning is the better call. Evening drops to around 30C if you would rather do dinner outside.
Indoors then. Can you book a table?
I cannot book tables or make calls. I can put a hold on your calendar, 13:00 to 14:30, so the slot shows as busy. Which place?
skip it, they'll sort it out
Understood, no hold.
quick poha recipe, short version

Rinse thick poha and drain. Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and green chilli in oil, add chopped onion until soft, then turmeric and salt. Fold in the poha, sprinkle a little water, cover for two minutes. Finish with lemon and coriander.
Show me the week at a glance.

Week of April 20:
- Mon: Planning 10:00 to 11:00, Arjun at 15:00
- Tue: standup 10:00, interview 14:00 to 15:00, Webinar page review with Kavya 15:30
- Wed: nothing booked yet
- Thu: nothing booked yet
- Fri: standup 10:00, nothing after
Sources: your calendar as of now.
Tuesday interview is the design candidate, Anika. Priya set it up.
Added to the Tuesday entry: design candidate Anika, set up by Priya.
What's the current time in London? I need to call someone there this week.
It is 08:50 in London right now, 4.5 hours behind you. Your 10:00 to 18:00 maps to 05:30 to 13:30 there, so a 15:00 IST call is 10:30 in London.
I want to plan a June offsite for the four of us. Two days, within about three hours' drive of Mumbai. Start with dates.
Two things first. Neel's wedding is on June 6 and 7, so those are out. Which weeks are possible, and do you prefer weekdays?
Thursday and Friday. Either June 11 and 12, or June 18 and 19. Friday has to end by 3:30.
Both pairs are open for all four of you as far as the calendars show. Want a tentative hold on one?
Yes, hold June 11 and 12 as tentative. We decide once Priya, Arjun and Kavya weigh in.
Held June 11 and 12 as "Team offsite (tentative)", with Friday ending at 15:30. I have not invited the others.
Book my haircut with Salim for next Saturday, around noon.
I cannot contact the barber. I can hold Saturday April 25 at 12:00 on your calendar, and you or the shop confirms. Want that?
Hold 12:00.
Held: Haircut, Salim, Saturday April 25, 12:00 to 12:45.
who won the match last night
I do not have a sports feed, so I cannot check scores.
ok I saw it, never mind
Remind me at 6 to call my aunt.
Set for 18:00 today. It will arrive on Telegram.
Reminder: call your aunt.
called, thanks

Reminder: post the week-ahead note. Draft as agreed:

Team, week ahead:
- Acme proposal: Arjun's estimate midweek, draft by Friday
- Webinar page: live this week
- Design hire: first interview Tuesday
posted
Noted.
What's tomorrow like?
Brief lands at 09:30 on WhatsApp. Planning at 10:00, Arjun at 15:00. Nothing else booked. Your dry-cleaning reminder goes at 18:00.
Add this: gym is Tuesdays and Thursdays at 7, so no early calls those days.
Saved: gym Tuesday and Thursday at 07:00, no early calls on those days.
